description: This Dart source file defines a ProfileRepository class responsible for handling API calls related to user and patient profiles in a healthcare frontend application. It provides methods to fetch the current user's profile, create a new profile, and retrieve the current user's data safely.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository for API interactions related to patient profile and user data in the healthcare app.

methods.name: getMyProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's patient profile; returns Patient object or null if not found.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a new patient profile with optional details like age, gender, phone, and address, linked to a specified userId.

methods.name: getCurrentUserSafe
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current user object; returns User if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: _safeJson
methods.description: Ensures the response data is a Map<String, dynamic>, throws error otherwise.

methods.name: _unwrapCommonEnvelope
methods.description: Extracts the relevant nested data from common API envelope structures.
